purpose: Part G — minimal additive representation for 'this exact stored email was observed on an authoritative current source on this date', distinct from email_confirmed_at (deliverability).

proposed_columns_on_coaches.name: email_seen_on_source_at
proposed_columns_on_coaches.meaning: ISO timestamp the exact stored address was observed on a current authoritative page. NULL = never observed.

proposed_columns_on_coaches.name: email_seen_on_source_url
proposed_columns_on_coaches.meaning: the authoritative page URL where the exact address was seen.

naming_rationale: Matches the existing coach column style (email_status, email_source_url, email_confirmed_at, currentness_source_url). Parallel to currentness_checked_at/currentness_source_url.

rules.distinct_from_email_confirmed_at: email_confirmed_at stays reserved for proven deliverability (non-bounce/reply). email_seen_on_source_* records page-observation only.
rules.exact_match_only: Populate ONLY when the stored address string equals the address published on the page (case-insensitive). Never on a different-current-email, consumer/generic, or unpublished case.
rules.current_source_only: Only from a current authoritative page (staff/team/directory/roster), never a historical/archived page or an aggregator.

migration: Add via migrate.js COACH_COLUMNS (same idempotent addMissingColumns path as currentness_*). Not implemented in Part G; implemented only if needed for the Part J promotion simulation (simulated on a disposable copy).
candidates_now: Exact-match candidates from Phase 4A-4D external evidence: coaches with email_status=CURRENT_OFFICIAL_EMAIL (stored address exactly on the current page).
